description: Read a note or a span of it — by heading section, block reference, or line range. Returns structured JSON with the content, bytes returned, total note size, and a contentHash to pass as prevHash to edit tools for compare-and-swap. Use search or outline_note first to find the right path and section names.

block.description: Return only the line anchored by this block id (^ prefix optional).

includeFrontmatter.description: Prepend frontmatter to section/block span results. Default false for spans.

lines.description: Return only this line range (1-indexed, inclusive).

to.description: Last line (1-indexed, inclusive). Defaults to EOF.

section.description: Return only this heading section (heading text, # prefix optional). First match wins.

name: read_note
